items.quote: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel
items.claim: Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy elders of Israel ascended
items.actor: Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel

items.quote: And they saw the God of Israel
items.claim: They beheld the God of Israel

items.quote: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone
items.claim: A paved work of sapphire stone appeared beneath God's feet
items.object: a paved work of a sapphire stone

items.quote: and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness
items.claim: The body of heaven in clearness appeared alongside the sapphire work
